items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Yeah, big Heverset fella, he used to play drum.

ctx.x: You know who else you don't hear him mention? I don't know who anybody mentioned, no interview. Bama.

Oh yeah, he used to play drum, now he plays trumpet now. Yeah, Bama, yeah, that's right, Bama. He's from Seussberry. Seussberry's from Seussberry too. He's from Seussberry. Yeah, big Heverset fella, he used to play drum. Long Salmon.
